description: Follow or unfollow a game, a studio, a genre or a word in new games’ names (a trend), as the Follow and Save buttons in RoTerminal do: you then hear its big moments in your alerts (a game: records and breakouts; a studio: its new games and big moments; a genre or word: new games in it). Following is yours alone, never posted. following lists what they follow now.

target.description: game: its name, universe id or link; studio: one of its games or its roterminal.co/studio/ link; genre: like Tycoon or Tower Defense; trend: the word, like egg

name: follow
